Use the supplied query-property assessment only as an uncertain physicochemical prior. It is not experimental evidence or a label prediction. - Does this molecule share any structural motifs or elements that indicate that this evidence transfers to the query molecule?
- Does this record share any particular experimental context that would make it more relevant for the downstream label?

GLOBAL SYNTHESIS

- Do not narrate schema bookkeeping.
- Do not analyze the SMILES structure beyond what is clear.

The single low-bioavailability record for 13-cis-retinoic acid is outweighed by the broader retinoid derivative evidence.
